|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p3-16-Abyssin_Ornament.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: '''this page''' (original, release sheet of 11 May 2012); [[Abyssin Ornament (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Abyssin Ornament (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original); [[Abyssin Ornament (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Players Committee card image, uploaded 7 May 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"), page 3, slip 16 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>: “USED: Cancel an attempt to target your non-droid assassin (or a starship piloted by a non-droid assassin) with a weapon. LOST: Use 1 Force to take a just-lost non-droid assassin into hand.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-abyssinornament-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p3-16-Abyssin_Ornament.png]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 35) prints this text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E2 ([[Abyssin Ornament (V) (Errata 2)]]); the current text is the PC card image uploaded on 7 May 2013 ([[Abyssin Ornament (V) (Errata 3)]], the same words).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=35, page 35. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=35 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Abyssin Ornament (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “piloted by a non-droid assassin” to “piloted by one” and “just-lost” to “just lost”<ref name="cl-1281_16-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013 and on the Virtual Master list (VMasterType)</ref>: “USED: Cancel an attempt to target your non-droid assassin (or a starship piloted by one) with a weapon. LOST: Use 1 Force to take a just lost non-droid assassin into hand.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-abyssinornament-pre.gif]], undated) prints this text with “just lost” (no hyphen), a punctuation-only difference. No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-p3-16-Abyssin_Ornament-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Abyssin Ornament (V) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 35)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “USED: Cancel an attempt to target your non-droid assassin (or a starship piloted by a non-droid assassin) with a weapon. LOST: Use 1 Force to take a just-lost non-droid assassin into hand.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text); the PC card image uploaded later ([[Abyssin Ornament (V) (Errata 3)]]) is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-16-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Abyssin Ornament (V) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-abyssinornament-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “USED: Cancel an attempt to target your non-droid assassin (or a starship piloted by a non-droid assassin) with a weapon. LOST: Use 1 Force to take a just-lost non-droid assassin into hand.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual8-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 7 May 2013, 13:52<ref name="pcdir-Virtual8-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034744/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). Uploaded after the Master List, it is the latest version and so the current text. The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
